text.en: Nootropics are inherently low-risk because they're 'natural' cognitive enhancers rather than serious drugs -- in reality, several widely sold nootropics are unregulated synthetic compounds (many racetams) or prescription-only drugs bought without a prescription (modafinil), with real risks including drug interactions, unknown long-term effects, and in the case of grey-market suppliers, no guarantee the product even contains what the label claims.
text.et: Nootroopikumid on olemuslikult madala riskiga, kuna need on 'looduslikud' kognitiivsed tõstjad, mitte tõsised ravimid -- tegelikult on mitmed laialt müüdavad nootroopikumid reguleerimata sünteetilised ühendid (paljud ratsetaamid) või retseptiravimid, mida ostetakse ilma retseptita (modafiniil), millega kaasnevad tõelised riskid, sealhulgas ravimite koostoimed, teadmata pikaajalised mõjud ning hallturu tarnijate puhul puudub garantii, et toode üldse sisaldab seda, mida silt väidab.
